aliases: Upper Burrell former Alcoa campus data center
former Alcoa R&D campus data center
status_detail: TECfusions acquired the former Alcoa R&D campus/surrounding real estate and markets a 1,395-acre adaptive-reuse data center campus with 1 GW leased today and 3 GW total capacity; Westmoreland County minutes also reference a $2M RACP grant for the Keystone Connect Data Center project.
notes: County economic development page names TECfusions among announced energy/AI-related projects; county Sept. 11, 2025 minutes identify Keystone Connect Data Center and RACP grant; developer page gives 1,395 acres, 1 GW leased, 3 GW total capacity. Initial public announcement said 12 MW immediately available and 3 GW over six years.

aliases: Calpine York 2 Energy Center data center
Energy Capital Partners York County data center
status_detail: Energy Capital Partners announced plans for a $5B data center at Calpine's York 2 Energy Center in Peach Bottom Township; local reports citing York County officials say the project would create about 2,500 construction jobs. Capacity is inferred from the adjacent York 2 Energy Center's 828 MW power station capacity/access, not confirmed IT load.
notes: York County Planning Commission has official data-center guidance/white paper reflecting active county preparation; the project-specific details were found in local/trade news citing county/YCEA officials. Excluded Hands Mill Highway/Campbell Road QTS results because those are York County, South Carolina, not PA.
